entities.title: The pilot
entities.summary: Everything about the player that is saved, and the values derived from it.
entities.purpose: Declares the saved pilot of RULES A.7 (name, position, galaxy, cash, fuel, lasers, hold, cargo, fitted equipment, missiles, legal status, market and kills), the start pilot from GDD § 5.4, and the rank, legal label and contraband derived from it.
boundaries: A capability: it uses no feature or use case (tests/layers.rs).
Saving and loading the pilot is the saving feature's.
